propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries only when the forward entry carries a jira_key, leaving orphaned reverse keys permanently when forward entries lack jira_key or are removed by other means
Orphaned reverse keys surface as permanent store_integrity audit failures (reverse_missing_forward) that mask genuine integrity problems and cannot be cleaned up through any supported public API
Merge conflicts in bindings.json can drop forward entries wholesale via merge=ours strategy without corresponding reverse index cleanup, producing stranded reverse keys
A self-contained unbind() implementation that sweeps the reverse index for residual keys pointing to the local_id will clear orphans regardless of forward entry contents
A new rebar bridge fsck --repair flag with guarded deletion and durable audit logging can prune orphaned reverse entries through the existing public API
